papers.title: Training-Free Predictive Spatio-Temporal Token Pruning for Few-Step Autoregressive Video Diffusion
papers.abstract: Few-step autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models generate videos chunk by chunk and have made efficient video generation practical. However, further accelerating these models toward real-time generation remains challenging, as few-step distillation leaves little cross-step redundancy for existing training-free caching methods to exploit. We revisit this regime and identify two token-level redundancy patterns: cross-frame redundancy from static content shared across adjacent frames, and cross-step redundancy from tokens that converge early during denoising. Crucially, we find that early clean estimates along the model's own denoising trajectory provide an effective online signal for locating both patterns, requiring no retraining, auxiliary predictor, or reference video. Based on these findings, we propose PreSTP (Predictive Spatio-Temporal Token Pruning), a training-free framework that constructs a unified token-wise redundancy mask from cross-frame similarity and cross-step convergence. Tokens marked as redundant skip subsequent computation under a consistent last-computed-value restoration rule, and a content-adaptive mask reuse strategy further reduces dense probing cost. On 5-second generation, PreSTP achieves 1.52x-3.20x speedups and a better efficiency-fidelity trade-off than coarse-grained caching baselines such as TeaCache and FlowCache. On 30-second generation, it reaches up to 1.96x speedup while improving VBench-Long and suppressing long-horizon drift. Notably, it continues to reduce inference cost even in the extreme one-step regime, where cross-step redundancy vanishes entirely and coarse step-wise caching is no longer applicable.
papers.summary_cn: 论文提出 PreSTP，用模型去噪过程中产生的早期干净估计在线识别两类逐令牌冗余：相邻帧间静态区域的跨帧冗余，以及同一帧内较早稳定令牌的跨步冗余。方法通过统一掩码跳过冗余令牌，并用最近计算值保持输出和 KV 缓存一致；同时根据内容变化复用静态掩码，以减少探测开销。实验覆盖 CausVid、Self-Forcing、AnyFlow、LongLive 以及 One-Forcing、Causal Forcing++ 等模型，在 5 秒视频上最高加速 3.20 倍，在 30 秒视频上最高加速 1.96 倍，并通常保持接近或优于密集基线的质量和长时域稳定性。
papers.contribution_cn: 1. 识别并分析少步自回归视频扩散中的跨帧静态冗余和跨步收敛冗余，证明模型自身的早期干净估计可以作为无需外部参考的在线信号。 2. 提出 PreSTP，将两类冗余统一为在线逐令牌掩码，利用最近一次计算值恢复跳过令牌，从而保持输出布局和 KV 缓存一致。 3. 提出内容自适应的静态掩码复用和定期重新锚定机制，降低密集探测成本并缓解长期复用造成的漂移。 4. 在少步和单步自回归视频扩散模型上验证方法，在保持视觉质量的同时获得最高 3.20 倍加速，并改善部分长视频生成的稳定性。
papers.relevance_cn: 该工作直接面向视频扩散推理加速、实时生成、因果自回归生成和长视频生成。它不依赖重新训练或额外预测器，而是在推理时利用时空令牌冗余进行细粒度剪枝，适合少步蒸馏模型中传统跨步缓存收益有限的场景。其跨帧掩码复用和重新锚定机制与长视频闭环 rollout、历史上下文一致性及长时域漂移抑制密切相关；其单步模型实验也表明，跨帧剪枝在跨步缓存失效时仍然有效。论文主要关注视频生成加速，并未直接研究动作条件、交互式闭环控制或视觉世界模型中的策略反馈。
papers.limitations_cn: 加速效果依赖视频内容；对于运动密集、跨帧冗余较少的视频，收益会明显降低。方法只减少查询侧令牌计算，而注意力仍需作用于完整的历史 KV 上，因此未同时解决历史上下文压缩问题。静态掩码复用可能产生过时掩码误差，虽然定期重新探测可缓解该问题。论文当前实验主要基于 Wan2.1-1.3B、832×480 分辨率及若干特定自回归视频扩散模型，尚未覆盖更广泛的视频生成任务，例如图像到视频生成；对高度动态内容的冗余预测仍有待改进。
papers.abstract_cn: 少步自回归（AR）视频扩散模型以视频片段为单位逐块生成视频，使高效视频生成成为现实。然而，进一步将这类模型加速到实时生成仍然具有挑战性，因为少步蒸馏几乎消除了现有免训练缓存方法能够利用的跨步冗余。我们重新考察了这一场景，并发现了两种令牌级冗余模式：相邻帧之间由静态内容共享产生的跨帧冗余，以及去噪过程中较早收敛的令牌产生的跨步冗余。关键在于，模型自身去噪轨迹中的早期干净估计能够提供一种有效的在线信号，用于定位这两种冗余，无需重新训练、辅助预测器或参考视频。基于这些发现，我们提出了 PreSTP（预测式时空令牌剪枝），一种免训练框架，通过跨帧相似性和跨步收敛性构建统一的逐令牌冗余掩码。被标记为冗余的令牌在后续计算中跳过，并按照一致的“保留最近一次计算值”规则进行恢复；内容自适应的掩码复用策略则进一步降低了密集探测成本。在 5 秒视频生成任务中，PreSTP 可实现 1.52 倍至 3.20 倍加速，并且相比 TeaCache、FlowCache 等粗粒度缓存基线取得更优的效率—保真度权衡。在 30 秒视频生成任务中，PreSTP 的加速比最高达到 1.96 倍，同时提升 VBench-Long 得分并抑制长时域漂移。值得注意的是，即使在完全不存在跨步冗余、粗粒度逐步缓存不再适用的极端单步场景中，它仍能降低推理成本。

papers.title: GPWM: Modeling the World as 3D Particle Motion
papers.abstract: We introduce GPWM, a Generative Particle World Model that predicts how 3D scenes evolve by generating the motion of particles and rigid bodies over time. Unlike video world models that generate scene appearance, GPWM operates directly in 3D physical space. A single representation and architecture cover rigid, deformable, cloth, and granular materials, in both passive physics and robotic interaction. GPWM is an object-aware multi-resolution transformer that combines flow matching with diffusion forcing to generate coherent physical trajectories far beyond its training horizon. We train and evaluate GPWM on ParticleWorlds, a 25.5-million-frame corpus spanning diverse geometries, materials, interactions, and robot embodiments. GPWM outperforms the best prior learned-dynamics baseline in each of six physical domains, reducing prediction error by 31% on average. Breaking from the domain-specific setting of prior methods, a single Unified GPWM models these heterogeneous regimes with one set of weights, largely outperforming per-domain baselines and even surpassing our own specialist models in two domains. GPWM further generalizes to unseen geometries, physical properties, object counts, and rollout horizons. Beyond prediction, GPWM enables contact-rich planning by learning a generative prior over joint actuator-object motion. Instead of searching over unconstrained actions, planning searches the model's latent noise for interactions that achieve a desired object-space goal. With the same world model, noise-space planning substantially outperforms action-space search on pushing and picking, where complex contact sequences are hard to discover. Executed open-loop in simulation, the resulting plans achieve goal-directed manipulation without reference action trajectories or goal-specific policies.
papers.comment: 39 pages, 27 figures, 7 tables. Robert Ren and Matthew Bronars contributed equally (ordered by coin flip). Project page: https://robertren1122.github.io/gpwm/
papers.summary_cn: 论文提出 GPWM，将三维场景表示为粒子、刚体和执行器的运动，并用物体感知的多分辨率时空 Transformer 建模刚体、可变形体、布料和颗粒材料的动力学。流匹配与扩散强制支持流式、自回归的长时域生成，使模型能够在固定训练窗口之外持续推演。基于包含 2550 万帧、六类物理场景的 ParticleWorlds 数据集，GPWM 在各领域取得优于已有方法的预测结果，并展示了统一模型跨物理体系的泛化能力。进一步地，模型联合生成执行器和物体轨迹，通过在潜在噪声空间中进行优化，实现了基于物体目标的接触丰富操作规划。
papers.contribution_cn: 1. 提出 GPWM，一种统一建模粒子和刚体运动的生成式三维物理世界模型，覆盖刚体、可变形体、布料和颗粒等异构动力学。2. 设计物体感知的多分辨率时空 Transformer，通过对象内外的分层注意力提升对大规模粒子场景的建模能力。3. 将流匹配与扩散强制结合，采用逐帧噪声水平和交错去噪机制，实现稳定的流式长时域生成，推演长度可超过训练窗口 55 倍。4. 提出包含 2550 万帧、多种材料、几何形状、交互方式和机器人实体的 ParticleWorlds 数据集。5. 在六个物理领域中取得领先的动力学预测性能，并证明单一 Unified 模型可以跨异构领域学习，同时泛化到未见几何形状、材料属性、物体数量和推演时域。6. 学习执行器—物体联合运动的生成式交互先验，在潜在噪声空间中进行规划，从而改善推动、抓取等接触丰富任务的目标导向操作。
papers.relevance_cn: 论文与研究重点高度相关，但其核心输出不是像素视频，而是三维物理状态轨迹。它直接研究动作条件的视觉世界模型所需的物理状态预测、机器人交互和闭环模拟基础：执行器运动可作为条件输入，也可与物体运动联合生成，并能依据物体空间目标进行规划。其扩散强制和交错去噪机制与自回归、因果、流式及长视频生成密切相关，因为模型可以逐步提交近未来状态，同时继续修正远未来状态，并在固定训练窗口外持续生成。多分辨率对象级注意力降低了数千粒子场景的计算负担，与稀疏注意力和缓存式长时域推演具有相关性。不过，论文主要处理显式三维粒子/刚体状态，而非直接从视频生成视觉内容；因此它更适合作为三维物理世界模型和动作条件模拟器，而不是端到端的视频扩散模型。
papers.limitations_cn: 论文明确指出，GPWM 假设能够获得完整且具有时间跟踪关系的三维场景状态，因此实验将物理预测与感知分离，尚未解决从原始视觉观测中恢复持久粒子和物体身份的问题。统一模型在部分场景仍落后于领域专用模型，说明异构动力学之间存在干扰。潜在噪声优化需要对完整生成过程求导；长时域任务还需要跨多个流式窗口反向传播，因此规划计算成本会随时域增长，目前限制了快速在线控制。论文还指出，未来需要结合三维重建与跟踪，以直接从 RGB 或 RGB-D 视频学习物理世界模型。论文未明确说明真实机器人上的实际部署性能。
papers.abstract_cn: 我们提出 GPWM，一种生成式粒子世界模型，通过生成粒子和刚体随时间的运动来预测三维场景的演化。不同于生成场景外观的视频世界模型，GPWM 直接在三维物理空间中运行。单一的表示和架构即可覆盖刚体、可变形体、布料和颗粒材料，并支持被动物理过程与机器人交互。GPWM 是一种具备物体感知能力的多分辨率 Transformer，将流匹配与扩散强制相结合，以生成远超训练时域的连贯物理轨迹。我们在 ParticleWorlds 数据集上训练和评估 GPWM，该数据集包含 2550 万帧，涵盖多样的几何形状、材料、交互方式和机器人实体。在六个物理领域中，GPWM 均优于此前最佳的学习动力学基线，平均将预测误差降低 31%。不同于以往针对特定领域的方法，单一的 Unified GPWM 使用一组权重对这些异构场景进行建模，在很大程度上优于各领域基线，并且在两个领域中甚至超过了我们自己的专用模型。GPWM 还能够泛化到未见过的几何形状、物理属性、物体数量和推演时域。除预测之外，GPWM 还通过学习联合执行器—物体运动的生成式先验，实现了接触丰富的规划。规划不再搜索不受约束的动作，而是搜索模型的潜在噪声，以找到能够实现目标物体空间状态的交互。使用同一个世界模型，在推动和抓取任务中，噪声空间规划显著优于动作空间搜索；这些任务中的复杂接触序列很难被发现。在仿真中以开环方式执行时，所得规划无需参考动作轨迹或特定目标的策略，即可实现面向目标的操作。

papers.title: AR-Edit: Training-Free Autoregressive Video Editing without Inversion
papers.abstract: Editing a video stream in real time, without access to future frames, is essential for interactive applications. Existing training-free video editing methods, however, assume full offline access to the entire sequence, while streaming approaches either rely on additional training or are limited to specific editing techniques. We show that this limitation can be removed by analyzing the self-attention dynamics of DMD-distilled autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models. We uncover a key asymmetry: queries and keys remain stable and aligned with their source counterparts across denoising timesteps, while values diverge and encode the evolving content. Inherited from the non-distilled bidirectional teacher, this asymmetry is strongest at high noise, where few-step streaming models operate. The resulting mechanism is simple: a single forward pass suffices to capture source identity in the value features, which can be reused throughout generation. Starting from pure Gaussian noise and injecting only these source values reconstructs the input with fidelity matching or surpassing inversion-based methods, effectively eliminating inversion. Based on this insight, we introduce AR-Edit, a training-free, inversion-free method that caches source values once and selectively injects them during denoising. Across multiple AR backbones, AR-Edit enables real-time streaming editing with superior source preservation and tonal fidelity at minimal overhead.
papers.summary_cn: 本文研究DMD蒸馏自回归视频扩散模型上的实时、因果、免训练视频编辑。作者发现，在不同噪声时间步中，自注意力的查询和键基本稳定，而值特征显著变化并承载视频身份与内容。基于此，AR-Edit通过一次源视频前向传播缓存干净值特征，从随机高斯噪声出发，在目标提示词引导的少步去噪中选择性注入这些值，并利用Commit-then-Anchor策略保护未编辑区域。实验在Reward Forcing、CausVid和Self Forcing等AR骨干上表明，该方法无需反演或额外训练，在源内容保持、色调保真、视频质量和实时性之间取得了更好的平衡。
papers.contribution_cn: 1. 揭示DMD蒸馏AR视频扩散模型及其双向教师中的自注意力不对称性：查询和键跨噪声时间步保持稳定，而值特征发生明显变化并控制生成内容。 2. 证明从单次干净源视频前向传播得到的值特征，结合随机高斯噪声即可实现高保真源视频重建，使少步AR模型中的反演变得不必要。 3. 提出AR-Edit，一种无需训练、无需反演的流式视频编辑方法，通过缓存并选择性注入源值，在目标提示词下进行因果编辑。 4. 构建面向AR约束的流式视频编辑基准，并在多个AR骨干上验证了方法在源内容保持、伪影抑制、吞吐量和延迟方面的优势。
papers.relevance_cn: 与研究重点高度相关。该工作直接面向自回归、因果、流式和长视频生成基础设施上的实时视频编辑；利用DMD蒸馏将每个视频块的编辑限制在3至4步去噪，并结合滚动KV缓存维持跨块因果上下文。其核心技术是缓存和复用自注意力值特征，以避免昂贵的反演和多次网络评估，从而降低实时编辑的延迟与计算开销。实验报告了3至4步编辑、约10至12 FPS吞吐量及亚秒级首帧延迟，体现了对实时生成、缓存复用和少步蒸馏的直接贡献。该方法主要针对视频编辑，而不是动作条件视觉世界模型或闭环模拟。
papers.limitations_cn: 论文指出，AR-Edit存在源内容保持与目标文本遵循之间的权衡：增加值注入会提高源一致性，但可能削弱编辑语义；作者也明确承认方法会牺牲部分文本遵循度。该方法依赖DMD蒸馏的AR视频扩散模型及其少步高噪声工作区间，论文没有证明其适用于非蒸馏模型、低噪声采样或其他生成架构。评测基准由120个手工筛选的Pexels视频组成，规模和场景覆盖有限；用户研究仅包含20名参与者和33个视频。论文还未系统评估极长时间范围内的误差累积、复杂动态编辑、闭环交互模拟或更广泛的真实部署场景。
papers.abstract_cn: 在无法访问未来帧的情况下实时编辑视频流，对于交互式应用至关重要。然而，现有的免训练视频编辑方法通常假设可以离线访问完整序列，而流式方法要么依赖额外训练，要么仅限于特定的编辑技术。我们通过分析经DMD蒸馏的自回归（AR）视频扩散模型中的自注意力动态，证明了这一限制可以被消除。我们发现了一个关键的不对称性：在不同去噪时间步之间，查询和键始终保持稳定，并与其源对应项对齐；而值则发生偏离，并编码不断演化的内容。这种继承自非蒸馏双向教师模型的不对称性，在高噪声阶段最为明显，而少步数流式模型正工作于该阶段。由此得到的机制非常简单：只需一次前向传播，就能在值特征中捕获源视频的身份信息，并在整个生成过程中重复使用。从纯高斯噪声开始，仅注入这些源值即可高保真地重建输入，其效果达到或超过基于反演的方法，从而有效消除了反演过程。基于这一洞见，我们提出AR-Edit：一种无需训练、无需反演的方法，它只需缓存一次源值，并在去噪过程中选择性地注入这些值。在多个AR骨干模型上，AR-Edit以极小的额外开销实现了实时流式编辑，并在源视频保持和色调保真度方面取得了更优表现。

papers.title: Trajectory Forcing: Exploiting Diffusion Trajectories for Autoregressive Long Video Generation
papers.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) modeling is arguably the only way to extend a fixed-length video diffusion model to longer or even streaming videos. However, existing AR diffusion methods use only the previously predicted chunk as context for the next, discarding the intermediate predictions that constitute the chunk's generation history. In contrast, conventional AR models such as LLMs condition on the entire history of preceding tokens. To this end, we propose Trajectory Forcing (TraF), an AR diffusion method that exploits the denoising trajectories of previous video chunks as context. TraF operates under two training regimes: (1) with ground-truth videos, where pseudo-trajectories are constructed from Gaussian interpolations and re-predicted by the model, and (2) with a teacher model, where real trajectories are obtained from the student's own denoising rollout. The first regime naturally provides a strong initialization for the second. On the 5-second VBench benchmark, TraF achieves a Total score of 85.15, outperforming Self Forcing (+0.84) and Causal Forcing (+1.11), with Quality and Semantic improving simultaneously. On 30-second generation---6$\times$ the training horizon---TraF achieves the highest overall quality among all compared methods.
papers.summary_cn: Autoregressive (AR) modeling is arguably the only way to extend a fixed-length video diffusion model to longer or even streaming videos.
papers.contribution_cn: To this end, we propose Trajectory Forcing (TraF), an AR diffusion method that exploits the denoising trajectories of previous video chunks as context.
papers.relevance_cn: 匹配研究线：streaming video, video generation；关键词：autoregressive, streaming, long video, video generation, video diffusion
papers.limitations_cn: 规则模式无法可靠判断实验质量与论文局限。

papers.title: Dynamics-Informed Action Learning for Goal-Conditioned Latent Planning
papers.abstract: Latent world models enable visual control by planning action sequences in compact representation spaces, but a gap remains between how latent dynamics are learned and how they are used for planning. First, teacher-forced training does not expose the dynamics model to the recursively predicted latent states encountered during planning. Second, sampling-based planners typically initialize action search from goal-agnostic proposals, without exploiting the action-conditioned dynamics learned by the world model. We introduce Dynamics-Informed Action Learning (DIAL) to bridge these two gaps. During training, rollout alignment exposes the forward model to its own autoregressive latent predictions, while multi-step inverse supervision trains a lightweight inverse dynamics head to infer actions from latent-state transitions. We further apply the inverse head to model-generated transitions with its parameters held fixed, encouraging predicted rollouts to retain action-relevant information. At test time, DIAL autoregressively couples the inverse and forward dynamics to construct a dynamics-informed action sequence toward the goal, which initializes the mean of the Cross-Entropy Method (CEM) proposal distribution. The subsequent CEM search then refines this initialization using the standard sampling and updating procedure. Experiments across four visual control benchmarks demonstrate that DIAL outperforms existing latent world models and planning baselines in both standard and long-horizon scenarios.
papers.summary_cn: Latent world models enable visual control by planning action sequences in compact representation spaces, but a gap remains between how latent dynamics are learned and how they are used for planning.
papers.contribution_cn: We introduce Dynamics-Informed Action Learning (DIAL) to bridge these two gaps.

papers.title: WorldFoundry: Towards Unified Infrastructure for World Intelligence
papers.abstract: Visual generative models increasingly blur the line between synthesizing observations and simulating environments. Yet visual plausibility alone does not constitute successful world modeling: compelling outputs may lack persistent state, physical dynamics, or causally consistent responses to interactions. We define a generative world model as a predictive dynamical system that maintains a persistent, history-conditioned representation of an environment, updates that representation in response to actions or interventions, and generates temporally coherent trajectories that reflect outcomes under observed and counterfactual interventions. From this definition, we derive an intelligence-oriented framework spanning perceptual grounding, persistent state modeling, controllable transformation, dynamics-aware prediction, and closed-loop interaction. We present WorldFoundry, open-source infrastructure for reproducible inference and evaluation across video, 3D and 4D, embodied action, and interactive world systems. WorldFoundry unifies model and benchmark discovery, runtime and asset preparation, execution orchestration, artifact management, and interactive visualization, while modality-specific adapters preserve native inputs, execution semantics, output representations, and evaluation protocols. Explicit manifests, durable artifact contracts, and evidence-aware scorecards separate execution readiness from evaluative claims, making each claim traceable to its supporting artifacts. The catalog contains 270 model entries, 74 benchmarks, and 62 registered metric entries, with readiness and execution evidence recorded separately. WorldFoundry enables reproducible comparison of persistent, controllable dynamics across heterogeneous systems, advancing the field from perceptual synthesis toward measurable world intelligence.

papers.title: Semantically Aligned KV Cache Compression for Efficient Agentic Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.abstract: Agentic autoregressive video generation combines semantic planning, sequential generation, and visual verification for controllable synthesis. Growing visual histories enlarge the key-value (KV) cache, increasing memory use and attention costs across candidate rollouts. Existing compression methods primarily optimize individual generators without the planner's semantic constraints, risking low priority for states supporting requested attributes or actions. We introduce SemanticKV, a training-free method for semantically aligned KV cache compression. To our knowledge, SemanticKV is the first KV cache compression method for agentic autoregressive video generation that explicitly uses planner-extracted semantic constraints to guide retention. Text cross-attention identifies constraint-related video positions, whose self-attention queries are collected into separate groups. Attention weights are averaged within each group and maximized across groups, giving each cached entry a high score when strongly used by any represented constraint. A single top-k selection retains high-scoring entries under the memory budget, leaving their keys, values, and positions unchanged. For fixed query groups and equal entry costs, this selection minimizes an additive upper bound on worst-group discarded attention. The method operates independently within each candidate without retraining or additional video generations. We evaluate four AR video backbones on three benchmarks for 5-, 30-, and 60-second generation. On Causal Forcing at a compression ratio of 0.7, SemanticKV obtains a VBench Total Score of 84.10, compared with 84.05 for the strongest compressed baseline and 83.99 for Full KV. It achieves a 1.22x speedup over Full KV and reduces KV-cache memory from 6.04 GB to 1.81 GB, a 3.35x reduction.

papers.title: Tiresias: Towards Language-Conditioned World Models
papers.abstract: World models enable planning through internal simulation, while natural language provides intuitive task specification. Yet, language-conditioned world modeling remains fragmented across domains with disparate action spaces, datasets, and evaluation protocols. We introduce LCWM, a shared task that maps an initial agent-view observation and a language instruction to an action sequence that fulfills the instruction. Its accompanying benchmark, LCWM-Bench, integrates 15 datasets across navigation, robotics, 3D gaming, and driving under a shared action interface and evaluation protocol, pairing 142,987 episodes with 428,961 instructions in three styles. We further propose Tiresias, an agent that plans via selective imagination: a language-conditioned diffusion policy generates candidate trajectories, a trajectory ranker shortlists them, and a video-pretrained world model imagines their visual consequences. A visual ranker evaluates these rollouts, complementing trajectory scores to select the final plan. Tiresias achieves competitive planning and imagination performance on LCWM-Bench. Ablations demonstrate the complementary benefits of trajectory ranking and visual verification, while experiments with alternative proposal methods show that the trained rankers remain effective beyond our diffusion policy. Together, LCWM-Bench and Tiresias provide a unified evaluation setting and an effective starting point for studying language-guided planning through world models.

papers.title: DexForesight: Grounding Dexterous Policies with Implicit Spatial Foresight
papers.abstract: Dexterous manipulation requires rich spatial foresight over both the surrounding scene and the robot hand. Existing world-action models often acquire such predictive knowledge through explicit future prediction. We introduce DexForesight, a framework that learns spatial foresight implicitly by injecting dynamics-aware world representations into the latent space of a dexterous policy. During training, DexForesight learns an action-conditioned spatial world model from offline scene depth, kinematic hand geometry, and demonstration trajectories. The world model predicts 3D hand-point motion and visual feature changes, capturing both articulated hand dynamics and scene changes under demonstrated actions, including the motion of fingers occluded from the cameras. We then freeze the world model and align policy queries with its predictive world queries, transferring the learned spatial dynamics into policy latents and using them to condition action generation. At deployment, only the policy is retained, operating on RGB observations, language, and robot state without depth input or explicit future prediction. On 11 DexJoCo simulation tasks, DexForesight improves the overall success rate of the base policy from 49.4% to 60.5%. On three real-robot dexterous manipulation tasks, DexForesight achieves 58.3% success, compared with 50.0% for the strongest baseline.Project page https://dexforesight.github.io/

papers.title: LO-World: Unified BEV Latent Modeling for Joint 4D Occupancy and LiDAR Forecasting
papers.abstract: LiDAR point clouds and 3D semantic occupancy represent two distinct modalities capturing fine-grained metric geometry and dense volumetric semantics, respectively, holding natural potential for mutual complementarity. However, existing world models typically forecast these modalities independently or cascade them heuristically, missing the opportunity for reciprocal cross-modal regularization. To address this, we propose \textbf{LO-World}, a unified 4D world model that forecasts both modalities within a shared BEV latent space. This single-stream formulation enables dense semantics and metric geometry to mutually reinforce each other, while eliminating multi-pipeline redundancy. Specifically, LO-World couples an efficient hybrid range-voxel autoencoder with a flow-matching generator that caches historical context to reduce iterative sampling latency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LO-World outperforms prior state-of-the-art baselines, improving occupancy forecasting IoU by 10.9% and reducing LiDAR Chamfer Distance by 30.1%. Meanwhile, it sustains a real-time throughput exceeding $25$~FPS on a single RTX 4090. Our code is available at https://github.com/lzzzzzm/LO-World.
